_doc: Remote Config / feature-flag keys shared by iOS + Android (docs/specs/native-apps.md §4 'Cập nhật không cần duyệt lại store'). scripts/native/gen.mjs → Flags.swift (LKCore) + Flags.kt (:core). default = SAFE offline value (used when Remote Config never fetched or fails). type: bool | int | string. Add a key here, never in Swift/Kotlin.

sync_drive_enabled.desc: Use Google Drive appDataFolder as the primary sync store. OFF in M1: the live Capacitor app syncs over D1 (LK_SYNC.native=false), so native uses D1 too and the data never splits; Drive stays behind this flag

sync_d1_fallback.desc: Allow the D1 /api/sync fallback (Apple sign-in, Drive scope declined)

sync_push_every_ms.desc: Batch interval for background pushes (same cadence as web LK_SYNC)

content_remote_enabled.desc: Fetch signed server-driven content (Today config, module order, banners); off → bundled starter pack only

content_max_schema.desc: Highest content schema this build renders fully; newer docs are read best-effort

ai_enabled.desc: Kill switch for on-device / free AI features (off until M6 ships them)

ads_enabled.desc: Kill switch for ads (off by default; never on in lessons)

teacher_rive_enabled.desc: Animated Rive teacher; off → static 2D pose

migration_capacitor_enabled.desc: Run the one-shot Capacitor → native data export on first launch (C03)

min_supported_app.desc: Below this version the app shows a soft 'please update' card (never blocks offline learning)

vocab_img.desc: Vocabulary pictures (lesson pic exercise, word cards) – same tri-state as web config v.vocab_img: "on" = everyone, "off" = nobody, "" = staged rollout by vocab_img_pct over a fixed per-device bucket 0–99 (web/js/vocab-img.js mode(), vectors/vimg.json mode)

vocab_img_pct.desc: Staged rollout % for vocabulary pictures when vocab_img is "" (web vocab_img_pct, default PCT = 10); raise only after the web journey-e2e 'images on' gate (docs/LEXICON.md)
